name: zen-social-crm
description: Multi-Page Social CRM for Meta/Facebook with 2-way Messenger, Comments, Posts, Ads, CRM, and Analytics

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server && node server/dist/prisma/seed.js && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
